title: AI-DLC herdr pane settings
description: Settings of the ai-dlc plugin's herdr panes (Claude Code only), committed in .ai-dlc/herdr.json. They apply only when the session runs inside herdr (herdr.dev); outside it nothing is opened, whatever they say. Each key is read, highest first, from the env of .claude/settings.local.json (its x-env variable), the env of .claude/settings.json, the process environment, this file, then the default. null means not set here: the next source applies. An invalid value is reported and the next source applies. No key is trust-gated: no value can make the plugin do more than the Agent tool does.

mode.description: watch: a labelled pane per spawned subagent or teammate shows its progress; the agent itself is spawned with the Agent tool. run-in-pane: each subagent runs as its own claude process in a pane. off: no pane, even inside herdr. Agent-team stages always use watch. Applies only inside herdr.

runTimeoutMinutes.description: Minutes a run-in-pane agent may take before the script stops it and the run falls back to the Agent tool. Above 0, at most 720.
